name: git-guard
description: Stops risky git commands Claude runs through Bash (force pushes, pushes to main, reset --hard, clean -f, branch -D, discarding changes, dropping stashes, rebasing main), denying them or routing them to your permission prompt, each rule toggleable

action.title: Action on a match
action.description: deny refuses the command and tells Claude why; ask puts it to your permission prompt instead.

protectedBranches.title: Protected branches
protectedBranches.description: Comma-separated branch names that pushes and rebases are guarded on.

allowForceWithLease.title: Allow --force-with-lease
allowForceWithLease.description: Let git push --force-with-lease through the force-push rule (it still counts as a push for the protected-branch rule).

protectedPush.title: Guard pushes to protected branches
protectedPush.description: git push to a protected branch: named (origin main, HEAD:main), or implied (no refspec while on one), or --all.

clean.title: Guard clean -f
clean.description: git clean -f / -fd / -fdx (a dry run with -n is allowed).

discardChanges.title: Guard discarding all changes
discardChanges.description: git checkout -- . and git restore . (restore --staged alone is allowed).

stashDrop.title: Guard stash drop / clear
stashDrop.description: git stash drop and git stash clear.

rebaseProtected.title: Guard rebasing a protected branch
rebaseProtected.description: git rebase while on a protected branch, or naming one as the branch to rebase.
